message.content: Based on the discussion on 2026101, ChaeSong-hwa suggested several songs to be added to the gentle setlist for the community performance. These included "Landslide," which YurikoYamamoto described as a beautiful choice, and "Blackbird." Additionally, ChaeSong-hwa proposed "Sparks Fly," noting that it had a nice feel to it. The group agreed to keep the full rehearsals for Sunday night and look forward to jamming together. The setlist was intended to create a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere for their upcoming community performance.
